games.name: Life in Prison
games.desc:
Play Life in Prison!

# PC Keybinds
Shift - Run
Ctrl - Cam-lock
V - Cam-lock mode
C - Crawl
Backspace - Drop
R - Reload
E/Q - UFO Up-Down
Shift + Motorcycle - Wheelie
T + Police car - Siren/gate open
Right Mouse/Z - Scope
F - Punch/Detonate C4

# Mobile Keybinds
Drag items from inventory to drop
Customize touch layout in settings

# Controller Keybinds
L3 - run
Y - Crawl/UFO Up
B - Punch/UFO Down
X - Reload
D-Pad ⬆️ - Scope
D-Pad ➡️ - Cam-lock
D-Pad ⬅️ - Cam-lock mode

# Private Servers
As owner of a private server you unlock many commands to control the game.
/cmd - Terminal
/cmds - List commands

games.desc:

Win coins for every stage you finish. Use your coins to open boxes in the shop and see how many cool cosmetics you can get, Can you collect them all?

VIP server owners can use the settings menu to skip rounds, change the tower size, and lock the shop and commands in chat here:
/skip to skip tower
/setlength (number of stages 4-200) to set how many stages you want
/lock or /unlock to lock the shop
